# Slatebox documentation

> Slatebox is the free, open-source (MIT) visual intelligence platform for your team and agents. Invite any agent through MCP to work with you and your team on one live canvas: mind maps, flowcharts, diagrams, Gantt project plans, smart boards that keep rules, and presentations that compose themselves, edited live together. Run it on Slatebox Cloud or on your own server.

Official guides for using the app, building with SlateboxJS, calling the HTTP API, and self-hosting.

Start here: [Use Slatebox from your agent](https://docs.slatebox.com/Using-Slatebox/use-from-your-agent.md) · [GitHub mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Slatebox/slatebox-docs/retype/Using-Slatebox/use-from-your-agent.md)

Each guide has a GitHub mirror for command-line clients. You can also read [this index on GitHub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Slatebox/slatebox-docs/retype/llms.txt).

[OpenAPI schema](https://app.slatebox.com/api/v1/openapi.json)

For a self-hosted instance, read /api/v1/openapi.json on that instance to discover the operations it supports.

## Agents / MCP

- Hosted MCP server: https://app.slatebox.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP). Sign in with OAuth when the client connects, or send a personal token as a bearer token. A self-hosted Slatebox serves the same endpoint at /mcp on its origin.
- Tools: exec, always listed, runs a short JavaScript or TypeScript script against the typed Slatebox client; describe returns its methods and types. Beside them, one typed tool per client method (create_slate, import_mermaid, get_slate, edit_slate, export_mermaid and more), generated from the same contract; each is an exec script of one call, with the same checks.
- [Connect an assistant: Agents and MCP](https://docs.slatebox.com/Developers/SlateboxAPI/mcp.md) · [GitHub mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Slatebox/slatebox-docs/retype/Developers/SlateboxAPI/mcp.md)
- [Exec: how agents work with Slatebox](https://docs.slatebox.com/Developers/SlateboxAPI/exec.md) · [GitHub mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Slatebox/slatebox-docs/retype/Developers/SlateboxAPI/exec.md)
- Local server and CLI: the slatebox-mcp package. [Install it](https://docs.slatebox.com/Developers/SlateboxAPI/terminal-and-agents.md) · [GitHub mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Slatebox/slatebox-docs/retype/Developers/SlateboxAPI/terminal-and-agents.md)

## Paying for AI and calls on Slatebox Cloud

Everything above is free. On Slatebox Cloud, AI drafts and calls you start come with Slatebox Pro, or from a balance; a team can choose Slatebox Business. Current prices are on https://slatebox.com/plans/ only.

- [Pricing](https://docs.slatebox.com/Using-Slatebox/pricing.md) · [GitHub mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Slatebox/slatebox-docs/retype/Using-Slatebox/pricing.md)
- [Slatebox Business](https://docs.slatebox.com/Using-Slatebox/slatebox-business.md) · [GitHub mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Slatebox/slatebox-docs/retype/Using-Slatebox/slatebox-business.md)
- [Slatebox Pro](https://docs.slatebox.com/Using-Slatebox/slatebox-pro.md) · [GitHub mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Slatebox/slatebox-docs/retype/Using-Slatebox/slatebox-pro.md)
- [Top-ups and refunds](https://docs.slatebox.com/Using-Slatebox/top-ups.md) · [GitHub mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Slatebox/slatebox-docs/retype/Using-Slatebox/top-ups.md)
